title: HardwareTest authoring workspace
description: Versioned planning-directory manifest. Instrument requirements belong in TapPackage Dependencies. Session/DUT/Typst stay in {planId}.program.json.

$schema.description: Optional pointer to this schema for editor intellisense.

schemaVersion.description: Persisted document schema. Greater than the app current version loads read-only.

plansDirectory.description: Directory of *.TapPlan files, relative to this manifest. Top-level only.

instrumentComponentsPackage.description: Path to InstrumentComponents.OpenTap TapPackage, or omit and use HARDWARETEST_INSTRUMENT_COMPONENTS_PACKAGE.

recordingsDirectory.description: Directory of operator run.json goldens, relative to this manifest. Default recordings. Unused until recordings consume lands; the folder need not exist.

catalogs.description: Suggested report kinds, program kinds, required DUT field ids, and instrument slot names for this workspace. Not a closed demo-program list.
